author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Friday's relief rally (S&P 500 +2.24% to 4,384.65, VIX 27.59) priced the first, energy-sparing sanctions package, but the weekend's SWIFT exclusion of some Russian banks, Germany's EUR100 billion defence pivot and the EU airspace closure widen the shock into payments, energy and fiscal policy while the Fed still prices March lift-off (2Y 1.55%, +37 bps over 20 observations, bear flattening): own energy, defence, materials and quality defensives, keep hedges, and underweight European banks/autos, offshore China internet and Polish duration until talks show traction.
sources_policy: Only the 2022-02-28 frozen feed (tools/digest.py) and the 2022-02-28 market card (tools/showcard.py) were used; no other date's feed, card, spec, draft or note, no retail drafts and no web access. Every number is a card value (sessions 2022-02-25; crypto 2022-02-27) or appears in a headline cited in the same part; every citation is an own-date headline published before 2022-02-28T00:00Z within its window; each ID is used at most twice (264 distinct). Excluded ID n1971 is not cited. Live blogs (Reuters LIVE MARKETS) and live price pages were rejected. Previews (n0118 State of the Union March 1, n0212 two sessions, n2040/n2058 Fed March) are used only as pending events. No numeric spot-FX; currency direction (zloty, yuan, rupee, dollar) comes from dated headlines and DXY from the card. Period identities: Meta Platforms (FB), Block (SQ), Raytheon Technologies (RTX), Mercedes-Benz Group. No Polish companies in the Sector Deep Dive.
